meta_data.description: Realtime updates, presence (who's online), typing indicators and approvals for your Bubble app, on Hibira's hosted Pusher-compatible WebSockets. Drop a Hibira Channel element on a page, publish events from any workflow, and react to them instantly: live dashboards, chat, order tracking, notifications and collaborative pages. Free plan, no card.
meta_data.name: Hibira Realtime
meta_data.plugin_instructions:
Hibira Realtime adds live updates, presence ("who's online") and approvals to your Bubble app, over Hibira's hosted WebSockets (Pusher-compatible, servers in Asia). Free plan: 100 connections, no card. https://hibira.io

SETUP
1. Create a free account at https://hibira.io and create an app. Copy its App ID, Key and Secret (the secret is shown once).
2. On the app's Settings in the Hibira portal, add your Bubble domains to Allowed origins (for example https://yourapp.bubbleapps.io and your custom domain).
3. In Bubble, open Plugins > Hibira Realtime and fill in App key, App ID and App secret. Leave Host empty (it defaults to ws.hibira.io).

RECEIVE EVENTS
4. Drop a "Hibira Channel" element on the page and set its Channel, such as orders or "order-" & Current page order's unique id.
5. Add a workflow: When Hibira Channel an event is received. Read the element's Last event, Last data (text) and Last value (set Value key, such as status or order.status, to pull one value out of JSON data).

SEND EVENTS
6. In any workflow (front end or back end), add "Hibira - Publish event" with Channels, Event and Data (JSON or plain text, or Data fields key/value pairs). Pass a Hibira Channel's Socket ID in "Skip socket ID" so the sender doesn't get its own event.

PRIVATE AND PRESENCE CHANNELS
Channels named private-... or presence-... need your app's permission for each user:
7. Add a workflow: When Hibira Channel authorization is needed.
   Step 1: "Hibira - Authorize channel" with Socket ID = the element's Auth socket ID, Channel = the element's Auth channel, User ID = Current User's unique id, User name = Current User's name. Add an Only when condition to decide who may join.
   Step 2: the element's "Complete authorization" with Auth = Result of step 1's Auth and Channel data = Result of step 1's Channel data.
Presence channels then fill Member count, Member IDs, Member names, My ID, and fire "a member joins" / "a member leaves" (Changed member ID / name).
On private and presence channels, "Send client event" sends straight from the browser to the others (turn on client events in the Hibira app settings), for typing indicators and cursors.

APPROVALS
"Hibira - Request approval" returns an Approval link to send to a person (and can announce it on a channel or by push). "Hibira - Get approval" returns Status (pending, approved, rejected, expired), Choice and Comment; Wait up to 25 seconds for the answer.

TIPS
- Every Hibira Channel element on a page shares one connection, so one visitor counts as one connection.
- Several events can arrive faster than a workflow runs; use Event count or keep the event's data in one JSON event.
- Errors show in the element's Error state and fire "an error occurs". Server actions return Success / Error message instead of stopping your workflow.

Docs and source: https://github.com/hibira-io/bubble

AXB.caption: Channel
AXB.doc: Channel to join, such as orders, private-team-42 or presence-room-7. The prefix picks the type: private- and presence- channels need the "authorization is needed" workflow. Change it to switch channels; empty leaves the channel.
AXB.name: channel

AXC.caption: Only these events
AXC.doc: Optional. Comma-separated event names to react to. Empty: every event on the channel.
AXC.name: events

AXD.caption: Value key
AXD.doc: Optional. A key of the event's JSON data (dots for nested keys, such as order.status) copied into the Last value state.
AXD.name: value_key

AXE.caption: Member name key
AXE.doc: Presence channels: the key of each member's info shown in Member names. Default: name.
AXE.name: name_key

AXF.caption: Show status
AXF.doc: Show a small connection badge in the element. Off: the element draws nothing.
AXF.name: show_status

AXG.caption: Connection state
AXG.doc: initialized, connecting, connected, unavailable, failed or disconnected.
AXG.name: connection_state

AXH.caption: Socket ID
AXH.doc: This browser's socket ID. Pass it to "Hibira - Publish event" to skip the sender.
AXH.name: socket_id

AXI.caption: Subscribed
AXI.doc: yes once the channel is joined.
AXI.name: subscribed

AXK.caption: Last event
AXK.doc: Name of the last event received.
AXK.name: last_event

AXL.caption: Last data
AXL.doc: Data of the last event, as text (JSON for objects).
AXL.name: last_data

AXM.caption: Last value
AXM.doc: The Value key of the last event's data.
AXM.name: last_value

AXO.caption: Event count
AXO.doc: Events received since the page opened.
AXO.name: event_count

AXP.caption: Member count
AXP.doc: Presence channels: how many members are online.
AXP.name: member_count

AXQ.caption: Member IDs
AXQ.doc: Presence channels: IDs of the members online.
AXQ.name: member_ids

AXR.caption: Member names
AXR.doc: Presence channels: names of the members online (Member name key).
AXR.name: member_names

AXS.caption: My ID
AXS.doc: Presence channels: this user's member ID.
AXS.name: my_id

AXU.caption: Changed member ID
AXU.doc: The member who just joined or left.
AXU.name: member_id

AXV.caption: Changed member name
AXV.doc: The name of the member who just joined or left.
AXV.name: member_name

AXW.caption: Auth socket ID
AXW.doc: Pass to "Hibira - Authorize channel" when authorization is needed.
AXW.name: auth_socket_id

AXX.caption: Auth channel
AXX.doc: Pass to "Hibira - Authorize channel" when authorization is needed.
AXX.name: auth_channel

AXY.caption: Error
AXY.doc: The last problem, such as a refused subscription.
AXY.name: error

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pusher-js@8.5.0/dist/web/pusher.min.js"></script>
<script>
/* Hibira Realtime for Bubble: one shared WebSocket per app key, any number of
   Hibira Channel elements on the page. https://github.com/hibira-io/bubble */
(function () {
  if (window.HibiraBubble) return;

  var AUTH_TIMEOUT_MS = 15000;
  var connections = {};

  function parseHost(raw) {
    var host = String(raw || '').trim() || 'ws.hibira.io';
    var tls = true;
    var m = host.match(/^(wss?|https?):\/\//i);
    if (m) {
      tls = /^(wss|https)$/i.test(m[1]);
      host = host.slice(m[0].length);
    }
    host = host.replace(/\/.*$/, '');
    var port = tls ? 443 : 80;
    var pm = host.match(/:(\d+)$/);
    if (pm) {
      port = Number(pm[1]);
      host = host.slice(0, -pm[0].length);
    }
    return { host: host, port: port, tls: tls };
  }

  function splitList(value) {
    return String(value || '')
      .split(/[,\n]/)
      .map(function (s) { return s.trim(); })
      .filter(function (s) { return s !== ''; });
  }

  function toText(value) {
    if (value === undefined || value === null) return '';
    if (typeof value === 'string') return value;
    try { return JSON.stringify(value); } catch (e) { return String(value); }
  }

  function readKey(data, key) {
    if (!key || data === null || typeof data !== 'object') return '';
    var cur = data;
    var parts = String(key).split('.');
    for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
      if (cur === null || typeof cur !== 'object') return '';
      cur = cur[parts[i]];
    }
    return toText(cur);
  }

  function channelKind(name) {
    if (name.indexOf('presence-') === 0) return 'presence';
    if (name.indexOf('private-') === 0) return 'private';
    return 'public';
  }

  // Shared connection per app key + host. Private and presence channels are
  // authorized by the element that owns the channel, through a Bubble workflow.
  function connect(key, rawHost) {
    var h = parseHost(rawHost);
    var id = key + '@' + h.host + ':' + h.port + (h.tls ? 's' : '');
    if (connections[id]) return connections[id];
    var conn = { id: id, owners: {}, listeners: [] };
    conn.pusher = new window.Pusher(key, {
      cluster: 'hkg',
      wsHost: h.host,
      wsPort: h.tls ? 80 : h.port,
      wssPort: h.tls ? h.port : 443,
      forceTLS: h.tls,
      enabledTransports: ['ws', 'wss'],
      disableStats: true,
      channelAuthorization: {
        customHandler: function (params, callback) {
          var owner = conn.owners[params.channelName];
          if (!owner) {
            callback(new Error('No Hibira Channel element owns ' + params.channelName), null);
            return;
          }
          owner.authorize(params.socketId, params.channelName, callback);
        }
      }
    });
    conn.pusher.connection.bind('state_change', function (states) {
      conn.listeners.slice().forEach(function (fn) { fn(states.current); });
    });
    connections[id] = conn;
    return conn;
  }

  // One Bubble element instance. "bubble" is { publish(name, value), trigger(name) }.
  function Element(bubble) {
    this.bubble = bubble;
    this.conn = null;
    this.channel = null;
    this.name = '';
    this.pendingAuth = null;
    this.members = {};
    this.count = 0;
    this.options = {};
    var self = this;
    this.onState = function (state) { self.connectionChanged(state); };
  }

  Element.prototype.publish = function (name, value) { this.bubble.publish(name, value); };
  Element.prototype.trigger = function (name) { this.bubble.trigger(name); };

  Element.prototype.fail = function (message) {
    this.publish('error', message);
    this.trigger('error');
  };

  Element.prototype.update = function (props) {
    this.options = {
      events: splitList(props.events),
      valueKey: String(props.value_key || '').trim(),
      nameKey: String(props.name_key || '').trim() || 'name'
    };
    var key = String(props.app_key || '').trim();
    if (!key) {
      this.fail('Enter your Hibira app key in the plugin settings (Plugins tab).');
      return;
    }
    if (!window.Pusher) {
      this.fail('The Pusher client did not load. Check that cdn.jsdelivr.net is not blocked.');
      return;
    }
    var conn = connect(key, props.host);
    if (conn !== this.conn) {
      this.leave();
      if (this.conn) this.detach();
      this.conn = conn;
      conn.listeners.push(this.onState);
      this.connectionChanged(conn.pusher.connection.state);
    }
    var name = String(props.channel || '').trim();
    if (name !== this.name) {
      this.leave();
      if (name) this.join(name);
    }
  };

  Element.prototype.detach = function () {
    var i = this.conn.listeners.indexOf(this.onState);
    if (i >= 0) this.conn.listeners.splice(i, 1);
  };

  Element.prototype.connectionChanged = function (state) {
    this.publish('connection_state', state);
    this.publish('socket_id', (this.conn && this.conn.pusher.connection.socket_id) || '');
    if (state === 'connected') this.trigger('connected');
    if (state === 'unavailable' || state === 'failed' || state === 'disconnected') this.trigger('disconnected');
  };

  Element.prototype.join = function (name) {
    var self = this;
    var conn = this.conn;
    if (conn.owners[name] && conn.owners[name] !== this) {
      this.fail('Another Hibira Channel element on this page already uses ' + name + '.');
      return;
    }
    this.name = name;
    conn.owners[name] = this;
    var channel = conn.pusher.subscribe(name);
    this.channel = channel;
    this.publish('channel_type', channelKind(name));

    channel.bind_global(function (event, data) {
      if (self.channel !== channel) return;
      if (event === 'pusher:subscription_succeeded') return self.subscribed(data);
      if (event === 'pusher:subscription_error') return self.subscriptionFailed(data);
      if (event === 'pusher:member_added') return self.memberChanged(data, true);
      if (event === 'pusher:member_removed') return self.memberChanged(data, false);
      if (event.indexOf('pusher:') === 0 || event.indexOf('pusher_internal:') === 0) return;
      if (self.options.events.length && self.options.events.indexOf(event) < 0) return;
      self.received(event, data, name);
    });
  };

  Element.prototype.leave = function () {
    if (!this.channel) { this.name = ''; return; }
    var name = this.name;
    this.channel.unbind_global();
    if (this.conn.owners[name] === this) {
      delete this.conn.owners[name];
      this.conn.pusher.unsubscribe(name);
    }
    if (this.pendingAuth) {
      this.pendingAuth.callback(new Error('unsubscribed'), null);
      clearTimeout(this.pendingAuth.timer);
      this.pendingAuth = null;
    }
    this.channel = null;
    this.name = '';
    this.members = {};
    this.publish('subscribed', false);
    this.publishMembers();
  };

  Element.prototype.authorize = function (socketId, channelName, callback) {
    var self = this;
    if (this.pendingAuth) clearTimeout(this.pendingAuth.timer);
    var pending = { callback: callback, channel: channelName };
    pending.timer = setTimeout(function () {
      if (self.pendingAuth !== pending) return;
      self.pendingAuth = null;
      callback(new Error('No "Complete authorization" within 15 seconds. Add a workflow for the "authorization is needed" event.'), null);
    }, AUTH_TIMEOUT_MS);
    this.pendingAuth = pending;
    this.publish('auth_socket_id', socketId);
    this.publish('auth_channel', channelName);
    this.trigger('authorization_needed');
  };

  Element.prototype.completeAuthorization = function (props) {
    var pending = this.pendingAuth;
    if (!pending) return;
    this.pendingAuth = null;
    clearTimeout(pending.timer);
    var error = String(props.error || '').trim();
    var auth = String(props.auth || '').trim();
    if (error || !auth) {
      pending.callback(new Error(error || 'Authorization was refused (empty auth).'), null);
      return;
    }
    var result = { auth: auth };
    var channelData = String(props.channel_data || '').trim();
    if (channelData) result.channel_data = channelData;
    pending.callback(null, result);
  };

  Element.prototype.subscribed = function (data) {
    this.publish('subscribed', true);
    this.publish('error', '');
    if (data && data.presence) {
      this.members = {};
      var hash = data.presence.hash || {};
      for (var id in hash) this.members[id] = hash[id];
      this.publishMembers();
    } else if (this.channel && this.channel.members && this.channel.members.me) {
      this.members = {};
      var self = this;
      this.channel.members.each(function (m) { self.members[m.id] = m.info; });
      this.publishMembers();
    }
    if (this.channel && this.channel.members && this.channel.members.me) {
      var me = this.channel.members.me;
      this.publish('my_id', String(me.id));
      this.publish('my_name', readKey(me.info, this.options.nameKey));
    }
    this.trigger('subscribed');
  };

  Element.prototype.subscriptionFailed = function (data) {
    var message = (data && (data.error || data.message)) || ('status ' + ((data && data.status) || 'unknown'));
    this.publish('subscribed', false);
    this.fail('Could not subscribe to ' + this.name + ': ' + toText(message));
  };

  Element.prototype.memberChanged = function (member, joined) {
    var id = String(member.user_id !== undefined ? member.user_id : member.id);
    var info = member.user_info !== undefined ? member.user_info : member.info;
    if (joined) this.members[id] = info;
    else {
      info = this.members[id];
      delete this.members[id];
    }
    this.publishMembers();
    this.publish('member_id', id);
    this.publish('member_name', readKey(info, this.options.nameKey));
    this.trigger(joined ? 'member_joined' : 'member_left');
  };

  Element.prototype.publishMembers = function () {
    var ids = Object.keys(this.members);
    var self = this;
    this.publish('member_ids', ids);
    this.publish('member_names', ids.map(function (id) { return readKey(self.members[id], self.options.nameKey); }));
    this.publish('member_count', ids.length);
  };

  Element.prototype.received = function (event, data, channelName) {
    this.count += 1;
    this.publish('last_event', event);
    this.publish('last_data', toText(data));
    this.publish('last_value', readKey(data, this.options.valueKey));
    this.publish('last_channel', channelName);
    this.publish('event_count', this.count);
    this.trigger('event_received');
  };

  Element.prototype.sendClientEvent = function (props) {
    if (!this.channel || !this.channel.subscribed) {
      this.fail('Join a private or presence channel before sending client events.');
      return;
    }
    var event = String(props.event || '').trim();
    if (event.indexOf('client-') !== 0) event = 'client-' + event;
    var raw = props.data === undefined || props.data === null ? '' : String(props.data);
    var data;
    try { data = raw.trim() ? JSON.parse(raw) : {}; } catch (e) { data = { text: raw }; }
    if (!this.channel.trigger(event, data)) this.fail('Client events need a private or presence channel and client events enabled on the app.');
  };

  Element.prototype.reconnect = function () {
    if (!this.conn) return;
    var p = this.conn.pusher;
    if (p.connection.state === 'connected' || p.connection.state === 'connecting') return;
    p.connect();
  };

  Element.prototype.disconnect = function () {
    if (this.conn) this.conn.pusher.disconnect();
  };

  Element.prototype.destroy = function () {
    this.leave();
    if (this.conn) this.detach();
    this.conn = null;
  };

  window.HibiraBubble = {
    Element: Element,
    connect: connect,
    parseHost: parseHost,
    readKey: readKey,
    connections: connections
  };
})();
</script>

AXk.caption: Complete authorization
AXk.doc: Finish joining a private or presence channel. Run it after "Hibira - Authorize channel" in the workflow for this element's "authorization is needed" event, with that step's Auth and Channel data.

AXo.caption: Auth
AXo.doc: Result of step "Hibira - Authorize channel"'s Auth. Leave empty to refuse.
AXo.name: auth

AXp.caption: Channel data
AXp.doc: Result of step "Hibira - Authorize channel"'s Channel data (presence channels only).
AXp.name: channel_data

AXq.caption: Refuse with message
AXq.doc: Optional. A reason to refuse this user, shown in the element's Error state.
AXq.name: error

AXl.caption: Send client event
AXl.doc: Send an event straight from this browser to everyone else on the channel (private and presence channels, with client events enabled on the app). The event name gets the client- prefix if it is missing.

AXs.caption: Data
AXs.doc: JSON such as {"typing": true}, or plain text (sent as {"text": ...}).
AXs.name: data

AXm.caption: Reconnect
AXm.doc: Open the connection again after Disconnect. Hibira reconnects by itself after network drops.

AXn.caption: Disconnect
AXn.doc: Close the page's Hibira connection (it is shared by every Hibira Channel element on the page).

AYA.doc: Send an event to one or more channels. Every browser with a Hibira Channel element on those channels gets it.

AYa.caption: Channels
AYa.doc: One channel, or several separated by commas (at most 100).
AYa.name: channels

AYc.caption: Data
AYc.doc: JSON such as {"status": "shipped"}, or plain text (sent as {"text": ...}). Ignored when Data fields is filled in.
AYc.name: data

AYd.caption: Data fields
AYd.doc: Optional. Key/value pairs sent as a JSON object, instead of Data.
AYd.name: data_fields

AYe.caption: Skip socket ID
AYe.doc: Optional. A Hibira Channel's Socket ID: that browser won't get its own event.
AYe.name: socket_id

AYB.doc: Sign a private or presence channel subscription for the current user. Use it in the workflow for a Hibira Channel's "authorization is needed" event, before the element's "Complete authorization". Add an Only when condition to decide who may join.

AYj.caption: User ID
AYj.doc: Presence channels: a stable ID, such as Current User's unique id.
AYj.name: user_id

AYk.caption: User name
AYk.doc: Presence channels: the name others see (stored as name in the member's info).
AYk.name: user_name

AYl.caption: User info (JSON)
AYl.doc: Presence channels, optional: more member info as a JSON object, such as {"avatar": "https://..."}.
AYl.name: user_info

AYC.doc: Ask a person to approve or reject something. Hibira gives you a link to share (and can announce it on a channel or by push); check the answer with "Hibira - Get approval".

AYp.caption: Title
AYp.doc: What needs a decision, such as Refund order #1042 ($180)?
AYp.name: title

AYq.caption: Details
AYq.doc: Optional. More context shown on the approval page.
AYq.name: details

AYr.caption: Choices
AYr.doc: Optional. Comma-separated answers. Default: Approve, Reject.
AYr.name: choices

AYt.caption: Channel
AYt.doc: Optional. A channel to announce the request and its answer on, such as private-hibira-approvals.ops.
AYt.name: channel

AYu.caption: Asked by
AYu.doc: Optional. Who is asking, shown on the approval page. Default: Workflow.
AYu.name: agent

AYv.caption: Push to users
AYv.doc: Optional. Comma-separated Hibira push user IDs to notify.
AYv.name: push_users

AYw.caption: Push to interests
AYw.doc: Optional. Comma-separated push interests to notify.
AYw.name: push_interests

AYD.doc: Get the answer to an approval request. Status is pending, approved, rejected or expired.

AZC.caption: Wait (seconds)
AZC.doc: Optional, 0 to 25. Wait this long for an answer before returning pending.
AZC.name: wait_seconds

AYE.doc: List the users online in a presence channel, from the server.
